title: Masu Ibada da Aka Yi Alkawarin Yi
intro: Wani annabi mai daraja ya yi tafiya a tsakanin mutane, yana kiran su zuwa ga gaskiya. Mutane da yawa sun juya baya cikin taurin kai, amma wani ƙaramin da'ira mai aminci ya amsa kiran kuma ya yi alƙawarin kansa da zuciya ɗaya. An jarabce su da shakku kuma suka yi ƙarfin halin neman abincin sama. Ibadarsu mai ƙarfi ta zama darasi mai ɗorewa game da bangaskiya. Su wanene su?
clues: Mu ƙaramin rukuni ne da muka tashi don tallafawa wani aikin allahntaka a lokacin da aka yi rashin imani sosai.
Wani annabi mai daraja ya zo ya kira mu mu tsaya a matsayin abokan tarayya a tafarkin Allah.
Lokacin da annabi ya tambaya ko su waye za su zama masu goyon bayan Allah, mun amsa ba tare da wata shakka ba.
Mun yi ƙarfin halin neman a aiko mana da wani biki mai ban mamaki daga sama domin ƙarfafa zukatanmu.
Annabinmu ya tunatar da mu mu ji tsoron Allah idan mu masu imani ne na gaske, amma duk da haka an girmama bukatarmu ta tawali'u.
Mu ne da'irar ciki mai sadaukarwa wadda ta yi alƙawarin imani mai ƙarfi tare da Isa, ɗan Maryam.

Mutanen Madyana

trial.answer: Ana neman a zama masu goyon bayan tafarkin Allah

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
